function: Learned joint UAV 3-D trajectory (11 discrete moves) and per-device bandwidth allocation on UAV-MIoTD downlinks; only the bandwidth allocation is physical layer (pp. 3, 9).
system: 1 LEO satellite (550 km), 3 UAVs as base stations, 50 MIoT devices; OFDMA/NOMA downlink, 50 MHz; carrier frequency and antennas not stated; no RIS (pp. 5, 9, 12).
method: Multiagent DDPG (FC actor-critic, 128 and 256 neurons) per UAV with FedAvg at a ground station; GMM clustering (unsupervised); reinforcement plus federated learning (pp. 10-12).
data_channel: Custom Python/TensorFlow simulation: LoS free-space path loss on UAV-satellite and UAV-MIoTD links, random-walk device mobility; no standardized channel model or measured data (pp. 6, 12).
test_conditions: Trained 1000 episodes of 200 steps with 50 MIoTDs; Fig. 10 varies devices from 20 to 50; reuse or retraining per device count is not stated (pp. 12, 15).
baselines: Non-learned: none defined. Learned: FL-MADDPG without GMM [25], GMM-MADDPG, MADDPG [43], DDPG [51]; a 'Greedy algorithm' is mentioned once but never defined or plotted (pp. 12, 15).
metrics: System reward, communication coverage score, average data rate (Mb/s), Jain's fairness index, convergence episodes, execution time per episode and communication overhead (pp. 13-15).
complexity: Order e*T*sum(n_j*n_j+1) for training and |s_u|*|a_u| in real time; measured 4.41 s per episode, 17 MB communication overhead (pp. 11, 15, Table V).
openness: none; simulations used Python 3.12 and TensorFlow 2.12.0, with no code or data link or statement (p. 12).
q1_support: p. 6: "are predominantly governed by LoS connections" and "The free-space path loss model" (Eqs. 3-4). Custom LoS free-space simulator with random-walk mobility (p. 12); no 3GPP TR 38.811 or other standardized model and no measured data are cited.
q2_support: p. 15: "Fig. 10 illustrates how increasing the number of MIoTDs"; p. 12: "We analyzed 50 mobile MIoTDs". Fig. 10 sweeps 20 to 50 devices, but the paper never says the model trained with 50 devices is reused, fine-tuned, or retrained per count, and reports no unseen scenario, band, or site.
q3_support: p. 12: "baseline methods: GMM FL-MADDPG [25] without GMM," then GMM-MADDPG, MADDPG [43], DDPG [51], all learned; p. 15: "with the Greedy algorithm performing the worst". The Greedy algorithm is mentioned once, never defined, and absent from Figs. 5-10, so no non-learned baseline is reported.
q4_support: p. 11: "Thus, the overall computational complexity" of Algorithm 2 is given as an order expression in Section V-C; p. 15: "based on their average execution time per episode over 1000" (Table V, 4.41 s for the proposed method).
q5_support: p. 12: "GeForce RTX 3050 GPU, using Python 3.12 and TensorFlow". Custom simulator; no code or data link, DOI, or availability statement anywhere in the paper, and no public channel dataset.
notes: Borderline eligibility: UAV trajectory is above PHY, but the policy also learns per-device bandwidth allocation on aerial links (pp. 3, 9), counted as physical-layer resource allocation learned jointly with an above-PHY decision; included as area 6. The federated part is digital FedAvg at a ground station with an assumed error-free broadcast (p. 11), so it is not area 7. The 'Greedy algorithm' on p. 15 is not defined or plotted, hence q3 is 0. Hyperparameters in Table III differ from the values on p. 15. Tables III to V and Figs. 5 to 10 were read as images.
